Name: Bara Anthro Gus Overhaul PORTRAIT
Author: KagamiSora03
Description:
Since I don't understand English, the introductions are all machine translated, so it may be difficult to communicate in English. If possible, you can communicate with me in Chinese

Replace the original portrait file of the game with a picture of Gus that I drew myself

Use these two modules:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continue - （Furry Overhaul Mod） Plus Genderswaps[/url]

combined with

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22977]Stardew Valley Nexus 的 Bara Anthro 角色 - 模组和社区 （nexusmods.com）[/url]

Simply replace Gus's Portrait in the Antonio Characters Continue Portrait folder with an image.

Extract zip files and copy and paste them to replace the original files for proper functioning.
